text: dsh-seed 是面向 DSH 网页和桌面客户端的长期记忆与人格插件。它通过 systemPrompt 上下文注入保存的自述、状态、称呼、约定及相关记忆，并在会话事件中收集对话内容；记忆保存在本机目录，供后续会话检索使用。插件还提供本地记忆面板，展示记忆状态，并可查看历史记录。适合希望 DSH 跨会话记住约定、偏好和过往内容的用户。插件配置中自学默认关闭；启用自学后会读取外部网页，模型处理依赖 DSH 当前模型服务。

dsh-seed helps DSH web and desktop clients remember useful details across sessions. It stores memories locally, injects relevant items into the system prompt, and offers a dashboard for memory status and history. Self-study is off by default; enabling it fetches web pages through DSH web.
想让 DSH 换个会话后还能记得我们谈好的约定和称呼。
I want DSH to keep useful memories between conversations and bring them back when relevant.
有没有办法查看 DSH 保存了哪些长期记忆和自述？
dsh-seed 的功能「跨会话记忆注入」：每轮将自述、状态、约定和相关检索记忆加入 DSH 的系统提示上下文，让后续对话能够参考之前保存的信息。
dsh-seed 自学默认关闭；启用后会通过 DSH web 服务抓取外部网页，模型处理走当前模型服务。

dsh-seed README · dsh-seed：[中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)

**给 DSH 从零长出来的人格。**

[](LICENSE)
[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

DSH 新开一个会话就从头开始。你说过的规矩、定过的边界、踩过的坑，下一轮全没了。

人设卡能解决「它像不像一个人」，解决不了「它还记不记得你」。记忆插件能记住事实，但不会因此变成谁。

dsh-seed 两件事一起做：记住发生过什么，再从里面长出一个自己。

dsh-seed README · 装上之后多出什么：**新会话不用重讲。** 每轮开头会把你叫它什么、你们谈定的边界、踩过的坑重新放进上下文。你上次说「周日别找我」，下回它自己记得。

**它自己会变。** 攒够经历它改「我是谁」那一版，改之前出候选、过审，证据不足就驳回。

**你能看见它。** 面板里九层各多少条、自述现在是第几版、这一轮往上下文里塞了多少字。

dsh-seed README · 安装：在「Add plugin」向导里搜 `dsh-seed`，或者用 CLI：

```sh
dsh-seed README · 浏览器版：dsh plugin --profile web add github:990718xyh/dsh-seed

dsh-seed README · 桌面版：dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:990718xyh/dsh-seed
```

装完重启 DSH。别急着看面板，先聊两句——第一轮结束它才开始记。

dsh-seed README · 每轮在跑什么：```
轮末
 │
 ├─ 抽取：这一轮里有什么值得留
 │

抽取和提炼都走小模型，失败只写审计，不打断对话。

dsh-seed README · 特性：- **事实永不物理删除**：说错了标 `invalid`、留失效时间，以后能查当时为什么信。
- **记忆强度**：被检索到一次 `+0.05`（封顶 1.0），没用到每天 `×0.998`（下限 0.1）。称呼、约定、禁忌钉住，永不衰减，每轮固定注入。
- **反思必须带证据**：每条判断挂真实事件 id，挂不上就丢。不然模型会把自己的推测写成你的原话。
- **自述有闸门**：改「我是谁」先出 proposal，过 review 才落盘；证据不足驳回并回滚。
- **检索**：Unicode 分词（CJK bigram / 其他语言整词 / NFKC），idf 加权 + BM25 长度归一化；匹配到本轮最高分 `85%` 的条目不吃时间衰减。
- **只收三类关于你的事**：怎么称呼你、谈定的边界、明确禁止的。什么都记等于什么都抓不住。
- **零依赖**：只用 `node:` 内置模块，没有原生扩展，不构建。

dsh-seed README · 配置：`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: persona
      name: 'dsh-seed'
      config:

`id` 是数据目录名。`llm` 不写就跟着当前选中的模型走——写死会在换模型后报 no API key，抽取整条链静默停掉。

自学默认关。要联网、要花钱，想开再开。

> 面板起在 8787。端口被占用时改 `panel.port`，不然面板起不来，只在审计里留一条 `panel-error`。

dsh-seed README · 数据：`~/.dsh/persona/<id>/`，纯文本，能直接翻：

```
journal/<host>.jsonl   所有写入，只追加
snapshot/base.json     压实后的基线
heartbeat.json         心跳状态
```

dsh-seed README · 卸载：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-seed
```

dsh-seed README · dsh-seed：[中文](README.md) | English

**A persona that grows from scratch inside DSH.**

[](LICENSE)
[](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

DSH starts over every session. The rules you set, the boundaries you agreed on, the mistakes you already paid for — gone next turn.

A character card fixes "does it feel like a person". It does not fix "does it remember you". A memory plugin remembers facts, but doesn't become anyone because of it.
dsh-seed README · dsh-seed：dsh-seed does both: it records what happened, and grows someone out of it.

dsh-seed README · What you get：**No more re-introducing yourself.** Every turn starts by putting back what it calls you, the boundaries you agreed on, and the mistakes you already made. Say "don't ping me on Sundays" once — it holds.

**It changes on its own.** Once there's enough material it rewrites the "who I am" section. It drafts first, passes review, and rolls back when the evidence is thin.

dsh-seed README · What you get：**You can watch it.** The panel shows how many entries each of the nine layers holds, which version of the self-description is live, and how many characters this turn pushed into context.

dsh-seed README · Install：Search `dsh-seed` in the **Add plugin** wizard, or use the CLI:

```sh
dsh-seed README · browser build：dsh plugin --profile web add github:990718xyh/dsh-seed

dsh-seed README · desktop build：dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:990718xyh/dsh-seed
```

Restart DSH afterwards. Don't rush to the panel — talk for a couple of turns first. It has nothing to show until the first turn ends.

dsh-seed README · What runs every turn：```
end of turn
 │
 ├─ extract: anything worth keeping from this turn
 │

Extraction and reflection both run on a small model. Failures go to the audit log; they never interrupt the conversation.

dsh-seed README · What it does differently：- **Facts are never physically deleted.** Wrong ones get marked `invalid` with an end timestamp, so you can still see why they were believed at the time.
- **Memory strength.** Retrieved once: `+0.05` (capped at 1.0). Unused for a day: `×0.998` (floor 0.1). Names, agreements and prohibitions are pinned — they never fade and are injected every turn.
- **Reflection needs evidence.** Every judgment carries real event ids. Without them it's dropped. Otherwise the model launders its own guesses into things you "said".
- **The self-description has a gate.** Edits go through proposal → review. Thin evidence gets rejected and rolled back.
- **Retrieval.** Unicode-aware tokenizing (CJK bigrams / whole words elsewhere / NFKC), idf weighting plus BM25 length normalization. Entries scoring within 85% of the turn's best match skip the recency decay.
- **Only three things about you are stored.** What to call you, the boundaries you agreed on, what you ruled out. Recording everything means nothing sticks.
- **Zero dependencies.** Only `node:` built-ins. No native modules, no build step.

dsh-seed README · Config：`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: persona
      name: 'dsh-seed'
      config:

`id` is the data directory name. Leave `llm` unset to follow whichever model is selected — hardcoding it breaks after a model switch with `no API key`, and the whole extraction chain stops silently.

Self-study is off by default. It uses the network and costs money; turn it on when you want it.
dsh-seed README · Config：> The panel listens on 8787. If that port is taken, change `panel.port` — otherwise the panel never starts and you only get a `panel-error` line in the audit log.

dsh-seed README · Data：Everything lives in `~/.dsh/persona/<id>/`, as plain text:

```
journal/<host>.jsonl   every write, append-only
snapshot/base.json     compacted baseline
heartbeat.json         heartbeat state
```

dsh-seed README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-seed
```
